htmlContent.description: The page as OneNote HTML. The document title becomes the page title, and data-absolute-enabled/style attributes control positioning. Sent to Microsoft Graph as a text/html request body.

commands.description: A JSON array of patch commands to apply to the page, in order. Each command targets an element by data-id, generated id, or the 'body'/'title' keywords.

target.description: The element to update: a data-id, a generated id, or 'body' / 'title'

action.description: The change to apply to the target element

position.description: Where to place the new content relative to the target element

content.description: The new content, as OneNote HTML. Not used by the delete action.

displayName.description: The display name of the identity

pagelevel.name: pagelevel
pagelevel.description: Include the level and order properties of each page in the response

includeIDs.name: includeIDs
includeIDs.description: Return generated data-id values for the page elements, for use as patch command targets

preAuthenticated.name: preAuthenticated
preAuthenticated.description: Return pre-authenticated image and file URLs that are valid for one hour

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

ForbiddenError.description: The authenticated user does not have permission to perform this operation

NotFoundError.description: The requested resource was not found

BadRequestError.description: The request is malformed or invalid
